$comment: Canonical framework patch set. pnpm only honors patchedDependencies at the app/workspace root, so these ship inside @octane-xplat/cli and downstream apps materialize them via `xplat patches apply` (copies files into <app>/patches/ + merges the yaml block). `pnpm sync:patches` generates the config package's patch files and the template config; `pnpm check:patches` fails on drift. Maintain a patch with `pnpm patch <specifier>` + `pnpm patch-commit` — the root workspace yaml points here so commit writes land in this dir.

patches.why: Published octane 0.6.3 lacks live signal reads under universal renderers. Adds signal ownership, read tracking, and local signal hooks; JSX prop lowering and __methodDep already ship upstream. Routes uncaught universal event-handler errors to onUncaughtError when configured. Pins instance signal/query declarations to their declaring owner so child reads and event handlers share one request.
patches.dropWhen: An octane release ships universal signal reads and the workspace upgrades to that release and forwards uncaught event-handler errors to the root callback and preserves instance declaration ownership across child readers

patches.why: FlexboxLayout getChildMeasureSpec subtracts the child's own padding where AOSP subtracts parent padding + child margins — a column-stretched row re-measurement clamps padded children (37→17 dip, squished controls). Adds squircle (continuous) corner clipping for iOS backgrounds and CSS @layer cascade support to the native css-tree adapter (layer nodes, first-seen layerPath ordinals, layer rank ahead of specificity with unlayered last — sans !important). Ports the runtime half of NativeScript PR #11446 (fixes #11444): TabView onItemsChanged keeps retained items attached instead of unloading/re-adding them (the churn that left TabViewItem-hosted Frames isLoaded=false on iOS and detached from their tab fragment on Android), iOS items writes load the selected item's view once controllers exist, and Frame._pushInFrameStack only promotes frames whose ancestors present them (Frame.topmost stops returning hidden preloaded tab frames). Also maps CSS font-weight to the OpenType wght axis for custom Android fonts on API 26+, preserves explicit variation settings, and falls back to the prior file load when the axis is unsupported.
patches.dropWhen: @nativescript/core ships the measure-spec fix, corner-shape support, cascade layers (source lives on research/nativescript feat/css-cascade-layers), and the #11446 nested-tab-frame fix, and custom Android variable-font weight mapping

patches.why: @nativescript/vite serializes bundled CSS and dev app.css through reworkcss `css`@3.0.0, which mis-parses @layer into garbage selectors — rules die before reaching _populateRules. Adds atlayer() covering block and statement forms. Applies to a transitive dep — no app declares it directly.
patches.dropWhen: npm `css` is unmaintained — drop when @nativescript/vite's serializer stops using it (e.g. pointed at NS's vendored css/lib/parse; NativeScript#11462)

patches.why: Dev-server /ns/m fixes upstream still lacks (8.0.16 landed the pnpm transitive-dep probing, vendor-manifest gating, comment masking, /@fs→/ns/m anchoring, and active-platform-suffixed candidates): decode percent-encoded specs (bracketed route paths 404 otherwise), collect re-export specifiers in the .vite/deps rewrite (barrel modules skip the decode), route /@fs paths outside both roots through /ns/m (linked checkouts bypass the device transform upstream), and probe the non-active platform + `native` suffix tags in module candidates (upstream probes only the active platform). Deps-bundle alias: the dev payload's esbuild passes never see vite resolve.alias, so a dep importing bare `octane` bundles the DOM runtime beside the universal one (hooks crash on boot, octane-xplat#3) — an onResolve plugin redirects `octane` → `octane/universal/native`. tsconfig-paths resolver also probes the .mobile suffix tier (ios/android) between the os qualifier and unsuffixed default — .mobile-only modules behind paths-mapped imports fail bundle-mode resolution. The build-time ts checker's generated moduleSuffixes (['.<platform>', '.native', ''] upstream) gain the .mobile tier for ios/android/visionos — .mobile leaves otherwise 2307 under `ns build` while resolving in the app's own tsconfig and the bundler.
patches.dropWhen: @nativescript/vite ships the remaining /ns/m fixes (NativeScript/NativeScript#11455 for bracket decoding; re-export records, outside-roots /@fs routing, and multi-suffix probing unfiled); also drop the alias hunk when @nativescript/vite honors vite resolve.alias (or exposes an alias option) inside the deps-bundle esbuild passes; .mobile tier in typescript-check's generated moduleSuffixes tracked as NativeScript/NativeScript#11480

patches.why: Driver setProp skips `undefined` writes — NativeScript native setters coerce it (e.g. editable → ios.userInteractionEnabled = NO), leaving dead UI that still has its JS listeners. Advertises the implemented visibility capability so committed suspense bodies can be retained while pending.
patches.dropWhen: @nativescript-community/octane ships the undefined-skip and visibility capability

patches.why: octaneServerStrategy's SCRIPT_FILE_RE only covers [jt]sx? — .tsrx edits never emit the deferred ns:hmr-delta broadcast, so component HMR silently never reaches the device. Also counts open /ns-hmr sockets so the update summary stops reporting recipients=0 for delivered updates.
patches.dropWhen: vite-octane release adds .tsrx to the strategy's file matching

patches.why: Same dev-server fixes as the 8.0.16 patch, ported to the @11468 pkg.pr.new preview the windows target uses (apps/windows): /ns/m re-export records, vendor-manifest gating for plugin-patterned packages, percent-decoded specifiers, and the .mobile-aware tsconfig-paths probing.
patches.dropWhen: windows moves off the preview pin — the real fix lands upstream with the windows platform merge (NativeScript#11272/#11468)

patches.why: Windows spike: the shared-file subset of the 9.1.2 patch — @layer cascade machinery (css-tree parser, css-selector, style-scope), the #11446 frame/tab-view common fixes, and the flexbox common measure-spec — applied to the @11468 preview. iOS/Android impl-file hunks are dead code on windows and were dropped.
patches.dropWhen: upstream ships the fixes and windows moves off the preview pin (NativeScript#11462, #11446, core windows merge)

patches.why: Enables `resolveHiddenExtensions` on the language plugin's typescript facet so extensionless specifiers (e.g. './Text') probe `.tsrx` after moduleSuffixes — required for a single extensionless shared barrel to resolve per-platform leaves under tsrx-tsc and the IDE plugin.
patches.dropWhen: @tsrx/typescript-plugin sets resolveHiddenExtensions in its typescript facet upstream
